USER_NOT_ALLOWED: ⛔ This bot does not belong to you. Your id is $1 If you want to keep an eye on who joins your network from Telegram, deploy me on your server: everything is on GitHub and DockerHub.
USER_NOT_ALLOWED_SHORT: ⛔ You are not allowed to use this bot
STARTUP_MESSAGE: 🛡️ IntruBot 🟢 Active $1 ⏱️ Scanning every $2 📱 $3 known devices ⚙️ v$4
STARTUP_DATA_BROKEN: ⚠️ I could not read the device list. I moved it aside as $1 and I am starting from scratch: the first scan will register the network without reporting each device.
STARTUP_MIGRATED: 📦 I imported $1 devices from the previous version. They are now identified by their MAC instead of their IP, so an IP change is no longer mistaken for a new device. The names you gave them come back as they show up in the scans.
SCAN_ERROR_PERMISSION: ❌ I am not allowed to scan the network. The container needs network_mode: host and the NET_RAW capability (granted by default unless removed with cap_drop).
SCAN_ERROR_INTERFACE: ❌ I could not scan $1 through the $2 interface. Check that it exists inside the container. $3
FIRST_SCAN: 📡 First scan finished I registered the $1 devices connected right now. From now on I will let you know every time a new one shows up. Take the chance to name them from the list 👇
LIST_EMPTY: 📭 I do not know any device yet. They will show up after the next scan.
LIST_TITLE: 📋 $1 — $2 known · 🟢 $3 connected Tap one to see its details.
DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: ❓ That device is no longer in the list
RENAME_ASK: ✏️ Type the new name for $1 (up to $2 characters). Send - to remove its name or any command to cancel.
FORGET_CONFIRM: ⚠️ Forget $1 ($2)? If it is still connected, I will report it as new on the next scan.
FORGET_ALL_CONFIRM:
⚠️ Forget the $1 known devices$2?

The names you gave them will be lost. The next scan will register them again without reporting each one.
HELP: 🛡️ IntruBot watches your network and lets you know when a new device connects. /start - Network status panel /list - Known devices (rename, forget…) /scan - Scan the network right now /version - Current version /donate - Donate to the developer /donors - Heroes of IntruBot
VERSION_TEXT: ⚙️ Version: $1 Developed with ❤️ by @dgongut If you find any bug or have a suggestion, contact me. You can find everything about this bot on DockerHub or GitHub.
DONATE: This project is open source and I do it in my free time. Donating will not enable any extra feature. It is simply an ideal way to thank the work that a project like this involves. If you want to do it, click here. Thank you very much ❤️
DONORS_LIST: 🦸 Heroes of IntruBot $1 Thank you all for using the bot! A special thanks to these heroes for their generosity and altruistic spirit in making a donation with the /donate command. Your support makes a difference! 🚀💙
ERROR_GETTING_DONORS: ❌ Could not get donors. Try it later
SCAN_ERROR_NOT_CONNECTED: ❌ I cannot see $1: it is not directly connected to this machine (it is only reachable through the router $2) and ARP does not cross routers. The container needs an interface on that network: see "Several networks or VLANs" in the README.
SCAN_DONE_WITH_ERRORS: ⚠️ Scan finished: $1 connected, $2 new. $3 networks failed, check the alert I sent you.
FIRST_SCAN_NETWORKS: 📡 First scan finished I registered the devices connected right now: $1 From now on I will let you know every time a new one shows up. Take the chance to name them from the list 👇
NETWORK_NOT_FOUND: ❓ That network is no longer in the configuration
ALERTS_TITLE: 🔔 Alerts per network Tap a network to turn its new device alerts on or off. A muted network is still scanned and its devices still show up in the list.
